senses.gloss: (Shaf. of אֲנַץ; cmp. b. h. שנס) to squeeze in, fasten, lace.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:5:3">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>דהוא ש׳ גרמיה והיא נחתא</he> for when he laces himself (his shoes), it (the purple band) slips down.—Part. pass. <he>שָׁנִיץ</he>; f. <he>שְׁנִיצָא</he>, <he>שְׁנִיצַת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:7:4">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="S00432"><he>קוּנְטְרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:11">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כבר שניצת</he> (not <he>שנצת</he>), v. <cite ref="P00306"><he>עוּנְקְתָא</he></cite>.
